long_biography.plain_text:
After training in commerce, banking and computing in Switzerland, Werner Robert Wunderli moved into hospitality and wine in Provence. He and his wife, Carmen, were entrusted with turning a centuries-old vineyard hamlet near Gargas into Coquillade, working with investor Andreas Rihs on the capital-intensive redevelopment.

Wunderli directed the resort as it expanded across accommodation, restaurants, a spa, cycling facilities and the Aureto vineyard. His role joined development oversight with daily hotel operations and wine production, while Rihs supplied the principal investment behind the property. After leaving Coquillade management, Wunderli continued through French property companies and a father-and-son development venture based in Oppède.
